observations.body: Nadab and Abihu offer unauthorized fire and die; commands about priestly discernment follow, and Moses and Aaron dispute an uneaten sin offering.
observations.label: Unauthorized fire brings death and dispute

observations.body: The passage presents strange fire, divine holiness, priestly sobriety, teaching, grief, and eaten portions as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: strange fire, divine holiness, priestly sobriety, teaching, grief, and eaten portions

observations.body: The passage places unauthorized service beside strange fire, divine holiness, priestly sobriety, teaching, grief, and eaten portions.
observations.label: unauthorized service

payload.posture: Read Leviticus 10:1–20 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the chapter holds divine judgment and a reasoned priestly exception without treating them as the same failure
